ITEM 1 | Two triangular/rectangular flatbread-style slices with browned, slightly blistered edges, topped with orange-red tomato-like sauce spots and melted pale white cheese with browned patches; soft, moist top, sits at upper right of plate, covering roughly 12% of plate area, about 1.5 cm thick | 110
ITEM 2 | Cubed pieces of golden-yellow fried or roasted potato with browned edges and small green herb flecks, roughly 2 cm cubes with a crisp-looking dry surface, clustered in the center-right of plate, covering roughly 6% of plate area | 75
ITEM 3 | Shredded or flaked white creamy mixture with light golden-brown toasted spots, soft and moist with a slightly clumped texture, sits next to the potato pieces at right of plate, covering roughly 5% of plate area, about 1 cm high | 45
ITEM 4 | Small scattered crumbs of dark brown material, a few millimeters in size, dry and matte, sitting on the plate near the potatoes | 2
